verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog docs explicitly state it 'enforc[es] access control... track[s] lineage as data and AI assets are used, log[s] activity for auditing' automatically across the workspace, and separate mentions confirm lineage extends to the column level (Genie Code 'works directly with Unity Catalog tables, columns, and lineage'). Delta table history further supports auditing individual operations. missing for 10: no first-party detail on the audit-log delivery/export mechanism (e.g., account console audit log format, retention) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of column-level lineage accuracy.
